principle: One canonical subject; branch-specific differences are variants, not duplicated subjects.

variant_notes.french: Two validated curriculum families in the current repository: scientific/technical/management and letters/languages.
variant_notes.arabic: Keep one canonical subject with branch-family variants.
variant_notes.english: Official 3AS programme is shared across all six branches.
variant_notes.philosophy: Branch-family variants required; never merge scientific/technical/management/literary/languages resources blindly.
variant_notes.mathematics: Scientific/math/technical, management, and literary/languages variants are distinct curricula.
variant_notes.natural_sciences: Keep separate variants for Sciences Expérimentales and Mathematics where repository evidence confirms them.
variant_notes.third_foreign_languages: Spanish/German/Italian belong to Langues Étrangères as alternatives/options; do not duplicate them into other branches.
